content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know if it is possible to force outputs on or off in real time using [product_name] programming software, without needing to download the program?
Hello, No, you can only monitor the outputs live (online test), but you cannot change their state. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users want the ability to control outputs directly on [product_name] hardware in real time through the [product_name] programming software, without needing to re-download or modify the whole program. Currently, only output monitoring is supported, not modification, which restricts flexibility during testing or troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to force outputs on or off instantly using [product_name] programming software while the device is operational, without requiring a new program download for each change.
